$schema-note: Single source of truth for which public packages the automated npm release lane publishes. Every package under packages/ with a public publishConfig must appear in exactly one of enrolled/excluded, so adding a publishable package is a deliberate release decision instead of a silent one. Enforced by scripts/npm-release-plan.mjs (bun run check:npm-release). The public surface is the installable products (the CLI and the self-hosted scaffolder) and the design layer that console.genfeed.ai and marketplace.genfeed.ai install instead of vendoring: styles, ui, helpers and contracts. Everything else in packages/ stays internal (private: true) and resolves through workspace:*.
